Discrete fill scale for a feature track

Source: R/syn_track_geoms.R
scale_fill_syn_feature.Rd

Replace the colours of one feature track without changing gene, ribbon or other track colours.

Usage

scale_fill_syn_feature(
  track = 1,
  name = ggplot2::waiver(),
  values,
  na.value = "#BDBDBD",
  ...
)

Arguments

track

Track number in the order it was added, starting at 1.

name

Legend title.

values

Colours named by category, as for ggplot2::scale_fill_manual().

na.value

Colour for categories absent from values.

...

Further arguments to ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(), such as breaks, labels or guide.

Value

A ggplot2 discrete scale for the selected track.
